I feel it to be more likely that Rand will convince them of the necessity to break the seals, but they will convince him to wait. After all, he still has to "bind the nine moons to him," and that can only by done by apologizing to the Empress. Also, I feel that Shara will play a key role, as it was mentioned that there were dragonsworn in Shara. This could turn very much to Rand's advantage as the Ayyad (having been bred for thousands of years to channel) will likely be strong and numerous.
